chats.answer:
If you're looking for a 3D printer to make fidget toys, I recommend starting with an FDM 3D printer rather than a resin printer.

FDM printers are especially good for making:

Articulated dragons, snakes, and other flexible toys

Fidget spinners and clickers

Infinity cubes

Print-in-place gears and moving mechanisms

Sensory toys and keychains

For fidget toys, the most important features are dimensional accuracy, reliable first layers, and good print-in-place performance. These help moving parts print without fusing together.

My top 3 choices
Shop

1. Bambu Lab A1 Mini

Best for beginners

Approx. $200–$250 without multicolor

Easy to use, compact, and excellent for small fidget toys. 180 × 180 mm build plate.

Shop

2. Bambu Lab A1

Approx. $260–$350 without multicolor

My pick for printing lots of fidget toys or larger articulated dragons. 256 × 256 mm build plate.

Shop

3. Bambu Lab A1 mini Combo 3D Printer with AMS lite

$299.99 at Micro Center

Best for colorful fidget toys. Includes AMS lite for automatic printing with up to four colors.

These are also well suited to print-in-place models.
